Our Story

Fire, spice & family.

Fork & Feast began with one charcoal grill and a simple promise: every plate tastes like Sunday at home. We source our meat from local butchers, slow-roast over open flame and season with coastal spices — then serve it with kachumbari, ugali or hot crinkle fries.


🔥 Charcoal-grilled daily   🌿 Fresh kachumbari   ☕ Spiced chai & fresh juices
